Dataset Card for RefSegRS
	


This is a FiftyOne dataset with 4420 samples.

	
		
		Installation
	

If you haven't already, install FiftyOne:
pip install -U fiftyone


	
		
		Usage
	

import fiftyone as fo
from fiftyone.utils.huggingface import load_from_hub

# Load the dataset
# Note: other available arguments include 'max_samples', etc
dataset = load_from_hub("Voxel51/RefSegRS")

# Launch the App
session = fo.launch_app(dataset)



	
	
	
		NOTE: This dataset is .tif media, for best… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Voxel51/RegSegRS.
